title: The Simplest Side Hustle You Can Start Under $100
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Guest posts social videos about the business and runs a community/members group; mentions buying guides

idea.name: Shared postcard advertising via USPS EDDM
idea.one_liner: Sell one-per-category ad spaces to local businesses on a shared postcard mailed to 2,500-10,000 homes via Every Door Direct Mail; fill the front to break even, the back is profit
idea.customer: local home service and brick-and-mortar businesses
idea.offer: ad space with free design, offer help and dynamic QR tracking
idea.revenue_model: $250-1,100 per space; ~$9-10K revenue vs ~$4.8K cost per 10K-home card

key_quotes.quote: So, what I do is I sell advertising space to local businesses in my area on shared postcards like this.
So for every $10,000 mailing, you're hoping to profit between $4 and $5,000.
I probably close 95% of my deals over messenger or text.
My revenue has been about 26K, just to the shared cards, profit, 14K, and then profit would be probably about 11K.

claims.claim: ~$40K revenue, ~$15K profit in first year incl. solo cards
claims.quote: So, like 40 grand in revenue so far, 15 profit, give or take?
And that's gonna run you about $2,300 for 10,000 of those cards shipped printed to your house.

claims.claim: Plumber bought an $1,100 space after five messages
claims.quote: And I was charging $1,100 that space. He said, I'll do the $1,100 space.

claims.claim: Bakery on $350 3-month run got 15-18 coupon redemptions
claims.quote: I think she said she had 15 to 18 people total come in and redeem that coupon.

acquisition_channels.details: weekly posts in local business networking Facebook groups, Tue-Thu 6:45-7:15pm, self-engagement from business page
text/call businesses seen on yard signs and in groups

ideas.delivery: design in Canva, printer ships 14pt UV cards bundled in 100s to post office; EDDM route selection by income

uk_legal_risk.reason: Cold texts to sole-trader businesses found via yard signs fall under PECR

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK equivalent is Royal Mail Door to Door; CAP Code applies to ad content

idea.name: Wholesale iPhone parts to repair shops via direct mail
idea.one_liner: Moved to Dallas for one-day ground shipping reach, scraped ~3,000 repair shops and mailed a 6-postcard sequence, building a multi-million dollar business

key_quotes.quote: We built a multi-million dollar business just from Dallas with five or six pieces of direct mail to a few thousand a pair of shops.
At the time, I was selling wholesale iPhone parts to iPhone repair stores.

acquisition_channels.details: weekly direct mail sequence to scraped list

idea.name: Own a network of Facebook groups as a distribution channel
idea.one_liner: Start or buy niche Facebook groups (local business networking, or Buc-ee's fan groups with hundreds of thousands of members) and post your own offers and coupon codes

key_quotes.quote: Bucky's fans, Bucky's lovers, Bucky's, we bought them from other owners, we started them. They have hundreds of thousands of members.
People would be shocked at how organically you can get people to join your group by literally just creating it, filling out the info and waiting.
